key_impacts: Harbor walls were overtopped and waves flooded the shoreline and some city streets.
Damage reported to shoreline homes, public docks, cottages, and boat docks.
Water intake pumps were impacted by large water-level changes.
Water level fluctuations up to 0.5 m at the harbor gauge and about 2 m reported outside the harbor.
No injuries or fatalities were reported.
evidence_snippets: On April 13, 2018, meteotsunami waves struck the shores near Ludington, Michigan.
Harbor walls were overtopped; damage to shoreline homes and boat docks; water intake pumps were impacted.
Ludington harbor gauge recorded up to 0.5 m; 2 m fluctuations reported outside the harbor.
missing_information: Counts of damaged properties and economic losses not provided
